141-5686-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5686-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-5686-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-7316--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-7316--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

372-2511-4783.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Hellkite Courser and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2348-2597-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Cast Wild Growth by paying {G}, attaching it to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Wild Growth triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2348-2597-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

475-1379-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-2919-3197.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-4871-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2724-6432-7012.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Airbender Ascension. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

141-2921-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2921-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

1661-5078-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

240-2079-2438-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

413-628-7214.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Glen Elendra Guardian enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1669-1850-2573.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1669-1850-2573.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1680-4508-6310.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1680-4508-6310.description:
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat.
1680-4508-6310.notes: Once you have one opponent remaining, the loop fails to create enough Treasures to sustain itself. You may use other artifacts as desired or wait another turn until your artifacts are untapped. If you have more than two opponents, this combo will net Treasure(s) per loop, and those can also be used once you only have one opponent remaining.

1495-4613-5872-6843.description:
Activate Taii Wakeen by paying {1} and tapping it, increasing the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn by one.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Taii Wakeen.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

3240-6462-6560-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1339-3284-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3284-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

4215-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a green nontoken creature.
4215-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a green nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature from your library to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1166-3057-5658.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1166-3057-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker.
Satya triggers, creating a token copy of Bloodthirster that is tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Deal combat damage using the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Before the combat phase ends, activate Reconnaissance by paying {0}, untapping Satya and removing it from combat.
Repeat each combat phase.

225-575-2482-4121.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Birchlore Rangers.
When Birchlore Rangers dies, Yedora triggers, returning Birchlore Rangers from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Birchlore Rangers enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Birchlore Rangers.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

801-2816-3156-4763.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Impulsive Pilferer.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, targeting Koll.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

440-1339-1818-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1818-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-2018-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

requires.n: Legendary Creature with Flying and MV >= 4

2533-4050-5925--70.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the legendary creature with flying, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

457-1409-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
457-1409-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1223-2511.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
141-1223-2511.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-2079-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

4231-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4231-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any of the artifact tokens, adding {C}{C}.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

3862-4256-4613-5295.description:
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army token if you do not control an Army, then putting a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Orc Army using Magus of the Jar's ability by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling each player's hand and causing each player to draw seven cards.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card opponents draw this way.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a 0/0 Orc Army token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Holding priority, repeat from step 3 until you have six or less cards in your library.
Resolve the first remaining Orcish Bowmasters trigger, creating a 0/0 Orc Army token if you do not control one, then putting a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Orc Army that used Magus of the Jar's ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with them to their owner's hands.

141-3047-5256.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

351-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger attached to Famished Paladin.
You have a way to give Famished Paladin lifelink.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
351-3957.description:
Give Famished Paladin lifelink, if needed.
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

276-2988-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
276-2988-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, targeting yourself and causing you to gain 100 life due to Purity and Angrath's Marauders.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to any target.
Repeat step 3.

1864-2557-4050.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1864-2557-4050.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep creature tokens equal to twice the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Prossh and two Kobolds, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Choose to return Prossh to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Kobold, adding {1}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

776-2871-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Alena does not have summoning sickness.
A creature entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
If the creature that entered the battlefield this turn has less than 4 power, some starting mana is required.
776-2871-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding an amount of {R} equal to the power of the highest power among creatures that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Cast Seething Anger with its buyback cost by paying {3}{R}.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving your creatures +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving the targeted creature +3/+0 and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.
